item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=quantum+Fisher+information+environmental+monitoring+noise+robustness&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.5634697\", \"title\": [\"Variational Optimization of Quantum Fisher Information: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Approach to Noise-Resilient Metrology\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5634697\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.5765711\", \"title\": [\"Variational Optimization of Quantum Fisher Information: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Approach to Noise-Resilient Metrology\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5765711\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.26421/qic17.13-14-6\", \"title\": [\"Robustness of QMA against witness noise\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Using the tool of concatenated stabilizer coding, we prove that the complexity class QMA remains unchanged even if every witness qubit is disturbed by constant noise. This result may not only be relevant for physical implementations of verifying protocols but also attacking the relationship between the complexity classes QMA, QCMA and BQP, which can be reformulated in this unified framework of a verifying protocol receiving a disturbed witness. While QCMA and BQP are described by fully dephasing and depolarizing channels on the witness qubits, respectively, our result proves QMA to be robust against 27% dephasing and 18% depolarizing noise.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.26421/qic17.13-14-6\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2017, 11]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.7717/peerj-cs.3514/supp-14\", \"title\": [\"Supplemental Information 14: Robustness to Occlusion and Noise.\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj-cs.3514/supp-14\"}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "6e0fc0b75d66cff9a68e94b085040312c6a431d9ca3550d2504d0f002c3dc11e", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "record_robustness", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.2139/ssrn.5634697", "doi:10.2139/ssrn.5765711", "doi:10.26421/qic17.13-14-6", "doi:10.7717/peerj-cs.3514/supp-14"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5634697", "https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5765711"…
